features.text: Patient is 45 years old and female.
Patient was diagnosed with hepatitis C based on recent blood work.
Patient has not undergone prior testing or treatment for hepatitis C.
Patient has not undergone confirmatory testing for hepatitis C, such as HCV RNA or genotype testing.
Patient has not been tested for hepatitis C antibodies yet.
Patient has not been tested for hepatitis B or E.
Patient has not experienced jaundice or abdominal discomfort.
Patient experiences fatigue at the end of the day, which has been ongoing for a few months.
Patient does not know if the fatigue is related to hepatitis C or just due to being busy with work.
Patient has a history of intravenous drug use but has been clean for over fifteen years.
Patient has had multiple sexual partners in the past.
Patient is unsure if sexual activity with multiple partners is a risk factor for hepatitis C.
Patient has not had any blood transfusions or recent medical procedures involving exposure to blood.
Patient has not undergone liver function tests or imaging studies to assess liver damage.
Patient has not undergone HCV RNA testing to confirm active hepatitis C infection.
Patient has not experienced nausea, weight loss, changes in bowel habits, or jaundice since being diagnosed with hepatitis C.
Patient has not noticed any changes in appetite or bowel habits over the past few months.
Patient has not noticed dark-colored urine or pale-colored stools.
